title: Haye Karbala Ch Loko Kalla Hussain
body:
Haye Karbala ch loko kalla Hussain reh geya..
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Haye mar gaye putar bhira eday mitiyan tay aan beh geya..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Jeewain barchi sahi si Akbar di
Mot bardasht kiti Asghar di
Zakhm sab gin gin kay oh tera zarbaa’n seh geya ..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Teer saray tay kand day olay nay
Paar seenay day sirf nokaa’n nay
Ya Zahra jan’di ya Zainab teeraa’n toun keewain leh geya ..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Aenu sajday ch soch bhaina di
Aenu khanjar day war nahin dukhday
Khaima gah wal nazraa’n ker kay oh tera zarbaa’n seh geya ..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Jism teeraa’n day naal bhareya si
Zeen toun lath kay aaya nokaa’n tay
Teeraa’n tou Albright sajday lae Shabir keewain leh geya ..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Sheh di Saqlain aay wasiyat si
Matmi thanda peen jad pani
Oh meri payas nu yad rakhan Zainab nu janday keh geya ..
